title: Lightly Simmered Saudi Arabian Kinako Skewers
description: A tangy and crisp Saudi Arabian dish featuring kinako, perfect for crowds, and friendly to dairy-free diets. It is served on a wooden board.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together kinako, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the chicken breast pieces to the bowl and mix until they are well coated with the kinako mixture.
Thread the chicken pieces onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a wooden board and simmer in the oven for 20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the kinako skewers hot on the wooden board, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
Repeat the cooking process until all the skewers are cooked.
